 Description
The Uson Sprint iQ Medical Leak Tester is a cutting-edge device that revolutionizes the process of testing medical equipment for leaks. With its advanced technology and precise measurement capabilities, this tester ensures the utmost accuracy and reliability in detecting any leaks in medical devices. It is specifically designed to meet the stringent requirements of the medical industry, guaranteeing the safety and integrity of medical equipment. The Uson Sprint iQ Medical Leak Tester enhances efficiency by providing quick and accurate results, minimizing downtime and maximizing productivity. Its user-friendly interface and intuitive controls make it easy to operate, ensuring seamless integration into the testing process. Overall, the Uson Sprint iQ Medical Leak Tester is an indispensable tool for any medical facility or manufacturer, ensuring the highest standards of quality and safety in the healthcare industry.
Specifications 
– Model: Uson Sprint iQ Medical Leak Tester
– Dimensions: 10.5″ x 12.5″ x 4.5″
– Weight: 7 lbs
– Test Method: Pressure decay
– Leak Test Range: 0 – 100 psi
– Resolution: 0.001 psi
– Test Pressure Accuracy: ±0.1 psi
– Test Pressure Units: psi, bar, kPa, mmHg, cmHg
– Test Pressure Connection: 1/8″ NPT
– Test Time: Adjustable from 0.1 – 999.9 seconds
– Display: LCD screen with backlight
– Power Source: AC power adapter (100-240VAC, 50/60Hz)
– Communication: RS232, USB
